name: Skill Evaluator
headline: Skill Evaluator - Evaluates Claude Skills
short_description: Evaluates Claude skills across security, quality, utility, and compliance. Used by operations teams to assess skill performance and compliance with organizational standards. Integrates with Python workflows and Claude agents.
author: bjulius

sections.overview:
skill-evaluator is a comprehensive toolkit for analyzing Claude skills across four dimensions: security (35% weight), quality (25%), utility (20%), and compliance (20%). It performs pattern-based vulnerability detection with context-aware analysis and generates detailed markdown reports with executive summaries and risk assessments. The tool runs locally via Python scripts with cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Operations teams use it to assess skill performance before publication and validate alignment with organizational standards. v1.2.2 is production-ready with a 96.9/100 self-evaluation score.
Pre-publication security review before deploying skills to production
Compliance validation against organizational skill-creator guidelines
Automated assessment of third-party skills before internal adoption
Security-focused evaluation of skills in sensitive environments
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/bjulius/skill-evaluator`
sections.usage:
```
Evaluate the following Claude skill for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Assess it across security, quality, utility, and compliance. Provide a detailed report including strengths, weaknesses, and recommendations for improvement. The skill is designed to [PURPOSE]. Here is the skill prompt: [SKILL_PROMPT].
```
